title: [rangeslider] Let the user configure set the min and max values.
body:
There is an issue in Algolia engine that makes the empty query return wrong min and max values. One quick fix is to let the user configure a fixed min and max values.

What do you think?

comments.body:
Yes we should do it.

I think its a duplicate of https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/issues/858. If that's the case you lost 20 points in the contributor game. :D
